Committee: Economic Development and Tourism
Sponsor: Lawrence
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/02/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 356 as introduced could increase receipts to the Town Council of White Hall in Lowndes County by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of commission horse and greyhound wagering fees retained by the Town Council, if the Town Council allows pari-mutuel wagering on televised simulcast horse and greyhound races.
Becky Nordgren, Chair
Economic Development and Tourism
